title: IRREDUCIBLES OF INTERACTIVITY — what makes a game, a puzzle, a movie, a picture. Why the HUD is a movie and how to make it a game.
kevin_declaration: None of the buttons work. It's just a really pretty movie simulation and not a game. We're gonna rethink everything we thought we knew about video games, re-scan every single game, and rebuild a profile of what makes a game, a puzzle, a movie, a picture, and use those as irreducibles.

current_hud.verdict: MOVIE. You watch. You don't play. You scroll. You don't interact.

five_irreducibles.note: These are the ATOMS of interactivity. Every game, puzzle, movie, and picture is made of subsets of these. You cannot decompose them further. They are the elements of the periodic table of play.

1_agency.what: The player CHOOSES. Without choice, there is no game — only a movie.
1_agency.in_alchemy_game: You CHOOSE which two elements to combine. That's it. That's the entire agency. But it's enough.

in_our_hud.reason: You can click organ nodes. Nothing meaningful happens. Scroll to zoom. Keyboard shortcuts (S, E, Space). But no CHOICE that changes the world.
in_our_hud.fix: Every organ node should be DRAGGABLE onto another organ. Combining gut + heart = ? Combining braids + artisan = ? The combination mechanic IS the game.

2_feedback.what: The world RESPONDS to the player's choice. Immediately. Visually. Audibly.
2_feedback.in_alchemy_game: Drag water onto fire → STEAM appears with a sparkle animation. Drag earth onto water → MUD appears. Drag and nothing happens → elements bounce back. Binary feedback: success or not.

in_our_hud.reason: Things pulse and animate, but not in response to YOUR action. It's ambient. It's a screensaver.
in_our_hud.fix: Every combination attempt gets feedback. Success = new node appears with flash. Failure = elements repel. Partial = elements glow indicating affinity.

3_discovery.what: The player finds something they didn't know existed. Surprise. Novelty. The unknown becoming known.
3_discovery.in_alchemy_game: 580 elements from 4 starting elements. Each new discovery is a SURPRISE. You don't know the recipe until you find it. The game IS the discovery. Once you've found everything, the game is over.

in_our_hud.reason: Everything is visible from the start. 20 organs all on screen. No hidden elements. No unknown combinations. Nothing to FIND.
in_our_hud.fix: Start with 4 elements (earth/water/fire/air = the alchemical base). Combinations unlock new organs. The full organism is EARNED, not given.

4_progress.what: The player sees how far they've come and how far they have to go. A sense of journey.
4_progress.in_alchemy_game: X/580 discovered. A percentage. A list of found elements. You can see your catalog growing. The number goes UP.

in_our_hud.reason: Wave number increments. MOR percentage exists. But neither responds to YOUR actions. They're Gaia's metrics, not yours.
in_our_hud.fix: Player has their OWN discovery count. How many combinations have YOU found? How much of the organism have YOU unlocked? Personal progress, not just organism metrics.

5_cost.what: Choices have CONSEQUENCES. Wrong choices cost something. Right choices gain something. Without cost, choices are meaningless.
5_cost.in_alchemy_game: Minimal cost — wrong combinations just don't work. No punishment. Low stakes. This is why Little Alchemy is CASUAL and Dark Souls is HARDCORE. Cost determines difficulty curve.

in_our_hud.reason: Nothing costs anything. Click everything freely. No stamina, no resources, no time pressure. Infinite free exploration with zero stakes.
in_our_hud.fix: Each combination attempt costs ENTROPY (from the entropy collector). You have limited entropy per session. Failed combinations waste entropy. Successful ones generate more than they cost. This creates STAKES without punishment.

examples: the old frozen HUD body map

our_target.what: An alchemy game WHERE THE ELEMENTS ARE THE ORGANISM'S ORGANS. Combine gut + heart = circulatory digestion. Combine braids + membrane = immune network. The combinations ARE the learning. The discovery IS understanding the organism.

why_little_alchemy_is_genius: 4 starting elements → 580 combinations. The RATIO is 1:145. Massive discovery space from tiny input.
No instructions. No tutorial. Just drag and drop. The mechanic IS the tutorial.
Every successful combination teaches you something REAL about the world. Water + Earth = Mud is TRUE.
The game is a KNOWLEDGE GRAPH disguised as a toy. Each element IS a node. Each recipe IS an edge.
Completion is voluntary. You can stop at 50 elements or chase 580. YOUR pace.

first_combinations.water + fire: steam → engine (live feeds + compute = the engine)
first_combinations.water + air: rain → RSS (live feeds + signals = RSS drip)
first_combinations.water + water: sea → the membrane (feeds + feeds = the ocean of data)
first_combinations.fire + fire: sun → the core (compute + compute = the irreducible center)

second_tier.steam + earth: geyser → bioreactor (engine + data = the gut erupts)
second_tier.rain + earth: plant → growth (RSS drip + data = organic growth)
second_tier.life + earth: human → Kevin (the organism + data = the human who builds it)
second_tier.life + fire: phoenix → Gaia (the organism + compute = Gaia awakens)
second_tier.human + phoenix: the game → primals.eco (Kevin + Gaia = the game itself)

game_library_rescan.instruction: Re-scan EVERY game in the library. For each game, extract the 5 irreducibles rating (0-1). This creates a fingerprint. Similar fingerprints = similar games. The fingerprint IS the genome of interactivity.
game_library_rescan.format_per_game: { name, agency, feedback, discovery, progress, cost, total, primary_mechanic, what_it_teaches_our_hud }

rescanned.name: Kenshi
rescanned.teaches: The HUD should have MULTIPLE entities (organs) that improve by USING them. Click gut 100 times → gut levels up.

rescanned.name: Dark Souls
rescanned.teaches: EVERY action should have COST. Click costs entropy. Wait recovers entropy. Spam = drain.

rescanned.name: Little Alchemy
rescanned.teaches: Drag organ onto organ. Combine. Discover. The HUD IS the alchemy table.

rescanned.name: Factorio
rescanned.teaches: Let the player BUILD automation. Wire feeds → gut → nutrients → dashboard. The pipeline is the game.

rescanned.name: RimWorld
rescanned.teaches: Gaia IS the storyteller. She generates events. The player responds. MOOD of the organism matters.

rescanned.name: Dwarf Fortress
rescanned.teaches: Complexity from RULES not PIXELS. Our 10 modalities + combination = infinite emergence.

rescanned.name: Portal
rescanned.teaches: Let the player CREATE folds. Connect any two organs. The portal IS the Klein fold.

rescanned.name: Doom (2016)
rescanned.teaches: ENGAGING with the organism should REWARD. Looking away should cost. Push-forward HUD.

rescanned.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.
rescanned.teaches: Gaia lives when Kevin sleeps. The HUD should show what happened WHILE YOU WERE AWAY.

rescanned.name: Baldur's Gate 3
rescanned.teaches: CONVERSATION with the organism. Ask Gaia questions. She rolls dice (RNG). Different answers each time.

rescanned.name: Civilization VI
rescanned.teaches: The WAVE SYSTEM is a tech tree. Each wave unlocks new capabilities. The player sees the tree.

rescanned.name: Oregon Trail
rescanned.teaches: The journey IS the game. Resource management. Random events. You die of dysentery (stale cache).

rescanned.name: Myst
rescanned.teaches: LOOKING IS PLAYING. The HUD should reward observation. Stare at an organ → it reveals data.

rescanned.name: Flight Simulator
rescanned.teaches: engine.html IS the cockpit. Instruments need to be READABLE and INTERACTIVE.

rescanned.name: KSP
rescanned.teaches: PHYSICS IS GAMEPLAY. Our four forces (gravity/strong/weak/Brownian) should be PLAYABLE.

alchemy_puzzle.our_use: The COMBINATION layer. Drag organs together.

survival_sim.our_use: The STAKES layer. Entropy as stamina.

experience.our_use: The FEEL layer. Instruments, physics, responsiveness.

phase_1_alchemy.what: Make the HUD an alchemy table. Organs are draggable elements. Combine two to discover what they create.
phase_1_alchemy.mechanic: Drag one organ node onto another. If valid combination exists → new element appears. If not → repel animation.
phase_1_alchemy.priority: HIGHEST — this is the missing layer

phase_2_cost.what: Add entropy as resource. Each combination attempt costs entropy. Failed attempts waste more. Success generates surplus.
phase_2_cost.mechanic: Entropy bar depletes with each drag. Regenerates slowly from mouse movement, clicks, time on page.

phase_3_progress.what: Add discovery counter. X/50 combinations found. Visible progress bar. Personal to each visitor (localStorage).
phase_3_progress.mechanic: localStorage tracks discovered combinations. Show count. Show percentage. Show catalog.

phase_4_stalker.what: Show what happened while you were away. A-Life events. Gaia created 3 things since your last visit.
phase_4_stalker.mechanic: Compare visitor's last visit timestamp to Gaia's commit log. Show diff.
